text: _aquatica_ Browny abbonen ovat and of an ash colour; the back brown, marked with two dots. 30. A native of Europe, in stagnant waters, where it direct to the bottom in search of the area. It takes up to winter quar-ters in an empty snail shell, the aperture of which it closes up with a web; jaws black, claws red.
